about: The monthly failure guards (doc 108), read by ./securax venture guards. Each guard names the failures it comes from and its line. Tighten a line here; never loosen one to make a red month look green.

guards.title: Cash runway (months)
guards.from: Dunzo, Byju's, Quibi: growth funded by burn until the cash ran out

guards.title: Burn multiple (net burn / new revenue)
guards.from: WeWork, Dunzo: each rupee of growth bought with several rupees of cash

guards.title: Largest product's share of revenue (%)
guards.from: Nokia, RIM, Kodak: one product's margin defended while the market moved

guards.title: Largest customer's share of revenue (%)
guards.from: Small B2B firms that lost one customer and with it the company

guards.title: Revenue backed by money received
guards.from: Byju's, GoMechanic, Builder.ai: revenue reported that was not there

guards.title: Independent review of the books
guards.from: Byju's (auditor resigned), Zilingo, GoMechanic, BluSmart/Gensol: no check outside the founders

guards.title: Claims the code cannot prove
guards.from: Builder.ai, Theranos: capabilities sold that did not exist

guards.title: Stop tests past their date
guards.from: Yahoo, Quibi: bets kept alive on hope after their test had failed

guards.title: Borrowing to run the business (Rs)
guards.from: Vijay Mallya (Kingfisher), Evergrande, Daewoo, Byju's Term Loan B: growth funded with debt

guards.title: Related-party payments without disclosure
guards.from: Rana Kapoor (charged), Chanda Kochhar (tribunal finding), Adam Neumann, BluSmart/Gensol (SEBI order): money to family or own firms

guards.title: Handover note kept current (days)
guards.from: Nithin Kamath's 2024 stroke and succession plan; Carlos Ghosn: everything resting on one person

guards.title: Name cleared and trade mark filed
guards.from: Fair & Lovely (a rival used the new name days before the launch), S. Syed Mohideen v Sulochana Bai (a prior user beats a registration), Satyam Infoway v Sifynet (a domain is a trade mark)

guards.title: Domain paid ahead (days left)
guards.from: passport.com (1999) and google.com (2015): a giant's own domain lapsed or was bought by a stranger

guards.title: Liability cover in force
guards.from: Maggi 2015 (a recall and a Rs 640 crore claim before the tests cleared it), Satyam (directors and auditors held to account)

guards.title: Bundled licences reviewed (days)
guards.from: Fair-code and branding clauses (n8n, Open WebUI) that forbid what a reseller assumes open source allows

guards.title: Platform shifts reviewed (days)
guards.from: Nokia (Symbian), RIM (keyboards), Kodak (film), Intel (mobile): the shift was seen and not acted on
